title: Ukusuka Ebunzini Bequla
intro: Uhambo lomphefumlo oselula lwaqala ngombono onamandla wezidalwa zasezulwini ziqubuda ngentlonelo. Ubomi balo mntu baphawulwa kukungcatshwa okukhulu ngabo basondeleyo, kwalandela iminyaka yobukhoboka kunye nokuvalelwa entolongweni ngokungafanelekanga. Kodwa ngenxa yokholo olungagungqiyo kunye nolwalathiso lukaThixo, lo mntu waphakama esuka emngxunyeni osezantsi waza waba ngomnye wabantu abanamandla kakhulu kubukumkani obukhulu. Ngaba ungamtyhila lo mkhonzi umangalisayo ka-Allah?
clues: Ndaboniswa umbono weenkwenkwezi ezilishumi elinanye, ilanga, nenyanga ziqubuda phambi kwam
Ndandingumntwana endimthanda kakhulu umzali wam, nto leyo eyabangela umona phakathi kwabantakwethu
Ndabanjwa ngabantakwethu, ndahlutywa isambatho sam, ndaza ndaphoswa emthonjeni onzulu nomnyama.
Ndathengiswa njengempahla emarikeni ndaza ndathwalelwa kude nelizwe lam
Ibhinqa elinamandla lazama ukungcolisa udumo lwam, ndaza ndaphoswa entolongweni ngenxa yokwala ukucela kwakhe uncedo
Ndasikelelwa ngesipho sokutolika amaphupha, ndaza ndavuka ekubeni libanjwa elilityalweyo ndaba ngumphathiswa omkhulu waseYiputa.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَكُمْ يُوسُفُ مِن قَبْلُ بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَمَا زِلْتُمْ فِى شَكٍّۢ مِّمَّا جَآءَكُم بِهِۦ ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا هَلَكَ قُلْتُمْ لَن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ رَسُولًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفٌۭ مُّرْتَابٌ
verse: And Joseph had already come to you before with clear proofs, but you remained in doubt of that which he brought to you, until when he died, you said, 'Never will Allāh send a messenger after him.' Thus does Allāh leave astray he who is a transgressor and skeptic." (40:34)
